decisions.reason: The existing message-684 MODIFY already records that mint number one awards no referral commission and limits the $5 commission rule to later primary mints.
The existing message-684 MODIFY already records the first-mint exception for both the randomly allocated commission and ticket.

The metadata rule requires randomly assigned rewards to be represented accurately and pairs each accounted ticket with a commission; it does not require a ticket or commission for every mint and remains valid under the first-mint exception.
The current FAQ describes rewards for successful referrals and general future operation; the accepted one-off first-mint exception does not necessarily require an FAQ copy change.
The source explicitly treats the first-mint condition as a one-off with no future effect, so it does not necessarily change the About page's general description of no-code reward allocation.

The existing message-684 MODIFY already changes ticket generation to one ticket per successful primary mint after mint number one, records that the first mint receives no ticket, and removes the superseded universal per-mint keys.
The Mission page describes rewards from successful referrals and does not assert that the first no-referral mint must receive a ticket or commission.
Allowing no reward on mint number one does not change which NFT identifiers qualify as valid referral codes.
The first-mint reward exception does not alter email delivery, notification triggers already defined for actual winners, or required email contents.
The accepted reward-accounting exception does not change wallet provisioning, wallet access, purchase confirmation, or reward cashout guidance for fiat buyers.
The landing hero describes referral rewards and prize entry at a promotional level and does not state a rule for the first no-referral mint.
The first-mint ticket and commission exception does not change referral-milestone badge eligibility, badge storage, or the approved badge set.
